run_paws_train: run the PAWS training script using a YAML config file on specified GPU devices
run_suncet_train: run the Suncet training script using a YAML config file on specified GPU devices
run_fine_tune: run the fine-tuning script using a YAML config file on specified GPU devices
run_snn_fine_tune: run the SNN fine-tuning script using a YAML config file on specified GPU devices
run_process_main: run the multi-GPU process main function with a config file and selected training script
